description.value: Table: Summon Nature's Ally VI Creature Subtype(s) Alphatusk — Barette — Cave Antlion (1/day Venom Spray) — Dark Wolf (1/day Breath) — Elemental (Huge) (Elemental, Extraplanar) Fell Tortoise (1/day Breath) — Groundpede — Hitobosu (5 MP, no invisibility) (Lightning) Nashorn (1/day Breath) — Ruby (5 MP, no invisibility) (Fire) Ruhk (1/day Breath Wing) (Avian) Shiranui (5 MP, no invisibility) (Non-element) Spiracorn (1/day Greater Bestial Fang) — St Elmo (5 MP, no invisibility) (Holy) Yellowtooth — Wolf Spider — This spell functions like Summon Nature’s Ally I , except that you can summon one creature from the 6th-level list with a CR rating of 8 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 5th-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 4th-level or lower lists.
